summary.text: Catherine Rombeau is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 2 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rombeau is an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Catherine Rombeau was born in Madison, Connecticut, and lives in Bedford, New Hampshire.
She earned an undergraduate degree from Amherst College and a law degree from New York University.
Rombeau ran unsuccessfully in the general elections for Hillsborough 7 in 2018 and 2020, according to Ballotpedia's campaign finance records.
She then won the special general election for Hillsborough 7 on September 7, 2021, defeating Linda Camarota.
Ballotpedia lists her as winning the Hillsborough 2 general elections in 2022 and 2024.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment was the House Transportation Committee.
